text: Continuous integration (CI) is a practice where developers regularly add their code to a shared project. Every time someone submits new code, automated builds start immediately. These builds compile the code and run tests to check that everything works correctly. By running tests automatically, teams can catch issues early, before they become serious problems. This saves time and reduces stress. CI pipelines organize all these steps into a clear process: building, testing, and reporting results. When a test fails, the team knows right away and can fix the problem quickly. In short, continuous integration helps teams work faster and produce more reliable software.
